2. Pursuant to the approval of the Board of Directors at its meetings held on May 26, 2026 and June 12, 2026, the Company entered into Master Framework Agreements and Business Transfer Agreements with the Akkodis Group for the disposal of the following identified businesses of the Company and its subsidiaries (Cades Studec Technologies (India) Private Limited, AXISCADES Technology Canada Inc., AXISCADES UK Limited, AXISCADES Inc., AXISCADES GmbH, and Epcogen Private Limited).

(i) Business of engineering services provided to customers engaged in the Aerospace industry, are proposed to be transferred through a business transfer and share sale structure for an aggregate fixed consideration of USD 152.35 million, including USD 74.65 million in the form of equity instruments of a newly incorporated entity, together with additional contingent consideration linked to the achievement of specified earn-out conditions.

(ii) Business of engineering services provided to customers engaged in the Heavy Engineering, Automotive and Energy industries, are proposed to be transferred on a slump sale basis for a fixed consideration of USD 23.23 million, including deferred consideration of USD 5.81 million receivable after 12 months, together with additional contingent consideration linked to the achievement of specified earn-out conditions.

The above transactions were approved by the shareholders of the Company on July 27, 2026 and were subjected to fulfilment of the conditions precedent set out in the respective agreements. The transactions were considered highly probable and expected to be completed within one year from the respective dates of Board approval. Accordingly, the related businesses had been classified as disposal groups held for sale and discontinued operations during the quarter ended June 30, 2026 in accordance with Ind AS 105, Non-current Assets Held for Sale and Discontinued Operations.

During the quarter ended September 30, 2026, the Company completed the transfer of control of its engineering services business serving customers in the Heavy Engineering, Automotive and Energy industries. Upon fulfilment of the closing conditions and transfer of control on September 30, 2026, the assets and liabilities pertaining to the aforesaid business has been derecognised and resultant gain of Rs. 14,083.74 lakhs, has been recognised in the Statement of Profit and Loss and disclosed as an Exceptional item. Upon loss of control, the cumulative exchange differences on translation of foreign operations of this business amounting to Rs. 2,093.90 lakhs is reclassified to the Statement of Profit and Loss.

3.
